mechanism: bounded ranked complete continuation verification and physical adaptive shape admission
implementation: original mlx2 host and lifecycle code
modifications: Verify up to 15 complete token continuation sequences in one request-private target forward; sample the processed target once at each reached prefix, then retain matching ranked branches.

Clone revision-bound target cache descriptors into independent private branch epochs and publish only one selected reached prefix. Unselected hybrid epochs close at their minimum anchor and are discarded.
Use actual target draws for source ranking and bounded LiLiCoRR shadow-training feedback only after every lane in an outer round commits; failed rounds discard all pending selection tickets.
Hash tenant, explicit session identifier and route revision for session ranking; anonymous requests use generator UUID plus uid to prevent unintended sharing across batch instances.

Expanded path verification costs are explicitly keyed by physical path width and proposal depth plus bonus. Lagged reached-prefix conditional Beta coverage chooses width/depth before target sampling. Unknown bindings, cold evidence and periodic exploration retain full physical shape. Chain cohort costs are never reinterpreted as expanded path costs.
Reserve conservative memory for private path branches and preserve ordinary decode, paired APCv2 sidecars and per-request RNG rollback.

cpu_evidence: Actual tiny standard Qwen3, GDN, pooled QSA and Mamba2+KV private branch prefix commit matches independent ordinary replay.
Greedy complete-path output matches ordinary tokens; mixed-temperature sampled laws match ordinary at each reached actual prefix and advance RNG once per delivered token.
Actual 15x3 verification forward, natural final-budget ragged paths, stop grammar reached-row censoring, paired APCv2 cold/warm resume and later-request atomic rollback.
Separate synthetic CPU cost tables demonstrate physical 15x3 to 1x2 adaptive trimming; these unit costs are mechanism evidence, not measured performance.
